name: CodeSandbox SDK

modes.label: VM credits, fixed sizes ($0.01486/credit, per started minute)
modes.note: Credits/h: Pico 5, Nano 10, Micro 20, Small 40, Medium 80, Large 160, XLarge 320 at $0.01486/credit (docs; marketing page rounds to $0.015 → Micro $0.30/h). Per started minute (3m25s bills 4 min). Billed on allocated tier, wall-clock while running incl. idle tail until hibernationTimeoutSeconds; hibernated = no credits. Plan caps: Build/Pro max Micro; Scale max Medium (16c/32GB); Large/XLarge Enterprise only. SDK vmTier param goes up to Small unless a custom template is built.

modes.label: Enterprise bulk VM credit packs (up to 50% off)
modes.commit_note: Prepaid bulk credit packs; pack size and exact discount negotiated. 50% is the published MAXIMUM ('up to 50% off'), so these rates are a best case.
modes.note: Enterprise plan only (Together sales). Custom concurrency, VMs up to 64 vCPU/128 GiB, optional dedicated cluster and SSO.

plans.name: Build (free)
plans.note: 400 credits/month (no rollover). NO on-demand credits: VMs freeze when the 400 credits run out, so total usage is capped at $5.94/month. 20 new SDK sandboxes/h, 1,000 SDK requests/h, 5 members. Verifier 2026-09-28: trial_only so the engine never auto-picks it: Build has no on-demand credits (VMs freeze at 400 credits), so fee 0 + usage - $5.94 would understate every workload above $5.94/month.

plans.name: Pro (legacy editor plan)
plans.note: 1,000 base credits/month; add-on credit packs with unpublished bulk savings; mandatory spending limit (VMs freeze at the limit). Fee not shown on current pricing page. 20 new sandboxes/h, 1,000 req/h, 20 members.

plans.name: Scale
plans.note: $170/month per workspace platform fee (not credit). Included credits: pricing page '160 hours of monthly VM credits' = 1,600 credits = $23.78 if Nano-hours; SDK docs example says 1,100 credits ($16.35). On-demand credits $0.01486 billed at month end. 1,000 new sandboxes/h, 10,000 req/h, up to 20 members.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Contact Together sales: bespoke concurrency and request limits, up to 50% off bulk credit packs, unlimited members, dedicated support.

extras.item: Extra VM storage beyond 20 GB ('more on demand', paid plans)

perf_source: ComputeSDK (github.com/computesdk/benchmarks results/): cold 2,329.37 ms (2026-08-07, SDK default tier), burst 7,657.92 ms (2026-09-25, composite 14.4), dax 81.23 s from the 2026-08-28 run on VMTier.Small (8 vCPU / 16 GiB); later DAX runs failed. Same VMs for on-demand and enterprise-bulk.

knobs.label: Idle tail before hibernation (x session hours)
knobs.why: VMs bill full credits while running idle until hibernationTimeoutSeconds fires (docs example 300 s); hibernated VMs consume no credits, and HTTP/WebSocket traffic auto-wakes them. Factor = (session + timeout) / session, e.g. 5 min on 15-min sessions = 1.33x.

knobs.label: Extra per-minute rounding from resume cycles
knobs.why: Billing is per started minute (3m25s bills 4 min) and each resume starts a new run. The card rounds once per session; with k hibernate/resume runs per session add ~0.5 min average rounding per extra run: factor ~ 1 + (k-1)*0.5/D minutes (judgment: uniform remainder). Max 1.5 = e.g. 11 runs in 10-min sessions.

caveats: Credit price conflict: docs/FAQ $0.01486 vs pricing page $0.015 (0.94% higher); card uses $0.01486.

Scale included credits conflict: pricing page '160 hours' (read as 1,600 credits = $23.78) vs SDK docs example 1,100 credits ($16.35) — the docs example is stale (also says 100 concurrent VMs; now 250).

free.monthly_credit ($5.94) is the Build plan allowance (400 credits, no rollover). Build is a hard cap (no on-demand credits; VMs freeze), so the Build plan is marked trial_only and never auto-picked; workloads under $5.94/month are really free but the estimate prices them on Scale.
Per-started-minute billing (min 60 s per run); short resume/exec/hibernate cycles are heavily rounded up.
Pico spec conflict: SDK docs 2 cores/1 GB vs pricing page 1 core/2 GB.

Hibernated/shut-down sandboxes consume no credits and no storage fee is documented (snapshot_gib_month 0 assumed from the documented 2-component billing model: credits + plan). Hibernated sandboxes are archived after ~7 days (resume 20-60 s).
Idle tail billed at full rate until hibernationTimeoutSeconds (docs example 300 s); automatic wake-up on HTTP/WebSocket restarts billing.
Egress not metered or published (null). No public IPv4.
Enterprise-bulk mode uses the maximum published discount (50%); actual discount negotiated. Pro add-on pack discounts unpublished; legacy Pro fee unpublished.
Regions not published / not selectable (features.regions null).
perf from benchmarks.json providers.codesandbox (computesdk): cold start median 2,329 ms, burst 7,658 ms, dax 81.23 s (dax last run success rate 0; value from 2026-08-28 run). No hpc CPU benchmark.

Re-checked 2026-09-28 (docs/sdk/faq and docs/sdk/pricing via headless Chrome): no SSH access and no egress/bandwidth price documented for SDK VMs (access is via the SDK Terminals/Commands API). ssh stays null, egress null.
